lens: Healthcare and industrials led a busy Tuesday: BioMarin agreed to buy Alesta for up to $490M (Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan) and the Huntsman/Olin chemicals merger set Aug 25 shareholder votes (Citi, Morgan Stanley, Lazard), on top of live TTM/Epiq, Gentherm/Modine, HomeTrust/Blue Ridge and Accelerant processes — even as the VIX popped ~8% on a risk-off tape.

stories.headline: BioMarin to acquire Alesta Therapeutics for up to $490M; Morgan Stanley advises BioMarin, JPMorgan advises Alesta
stories.why_it_matters: BioMarin Pharmaceutical (Nasdaq: BMRN) agreed to acquire Alesta Therapeutics to gain ALE1, a potential first oral therapy for hypophosphatasia (HPP), for $275M upfront plus up to $215M in development/regulatory milestones ($490M total); Alesta will spin out its non-ALE1 assets. Per BioMarin's 8-K, Morgan Stanley is exclusive financial adviser to BioMarin (buy-side; Jones Day legal) and J.P. Morgan is exclusive financial adviser to Alesta (sell-side; Goodwin Procter/NautaDutilh legal). A clinical-stage biopharma acquisition runs IP, milestone-structuring and integration workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Morgan Stanley (BioMarin) and JPMorgan (Alesta) — a milestone-structured biopharma acquisition runs IP, CVR/earn-out and integration diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: BioMarin agrees to acquire Alesta Therapeutics (up to $490M)

stories.headline: Huntsman/Olin all-stock merger heads to Aug 25 shareholder votes; Citi and Morgan Stanley advise Huntsman, Lazard advises Olin
stories.why_it_matters: Olin (NYSE: OLN) and Huntsman (NYSE: HUN) filed a supplemental proxy disclosure (Rule 425) ahead of both companies' special meetings on Aug 25, 2026 to vote on their all-stock merger (agreement dated Jun 15). The joint proxy names Citi and Morgan Stanley as Huntsman's financial advisers and Lazard as Olin's financial adviser (fairness opinions). The supplement responds to shareholder litigation seeking additional disclosures. A large chemicals merger runs antitrust, disclosure and dual shareholder-vote workstreams as it approaches the vote.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Citi/Morgan Stanley (Huntsman) and Lazard (Olin) — a chemicals merger heading to an Aug 25 vote runs antitrust and proxy-disclosure diligence a secure room organizes through close.

deal_clock.event: Huntsman and Olin special meetings (shareholder votes)

stories.headline: TTM Technologies' ~$1.1B acquisition of Epiq Solutions from Veritas advances; Guggenheim advises TTM
stories.why_it_matters: TTM Technologies (Nasdaq: TTMI) is acquiring Epiq Solutions — an ITAR-free provider of software-defined radios and RF/embedded computing for defense — from Veritas Capital for ~$1.1B all-cash, expected to close Q4 2026. Guggenheim Securities is exclusive financial adviser to TTM (buy-side; Polsinelli legal); JPMorgan, BofA and Barclays are providing committed financing (lenders, not advisers). A defense-electronics acquisition runs ITAR/regulatory, financing and integration workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Guggenheim (TTM) — a ~$1.1B defense-electronics acquisition runs ITAR/CFIUS, committed-financing and integration diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: TTM agrees to acquire Epiq Solutions from Veritas (~$1.1B)

stories.headline: Gentherm/Modine Reverse Morris Trust combination advances; Barclays advises Gentherm, BofA advises Modine
stories.why_it_matters: Gentherm (Nasdaq: THRM) will acquire Modine's Performance Technologies Business through a spin-off (Platinum SpinCo) and merger — a Reverse Morris Trust with ~$25M in identified synergies; registration effective Aug 12, Gentherm special meeting Sept 10. Barclays is financial adviser to Gentherm and BofA Securities is financial adviser to Modine. A spin-and-merge runs separation, Section 355 tax-opinion, exchange-ratio and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Barclays (Gentherm) and BofA (Modine) — a Reverse Morris Trust spin-and-merge runs separation, tax-opinion and dual shareholder-vote diligence a secure room organizes to close.
stories.source: SEC EDGAR — Gentherm/Platinum SpinCo Form 425 (joint proxy/prospectus)

stories.headline: HomeTrust's ~$448M all-stock acquisition of Blue Ridge Bankshares advances; Piper Sandler advises HomeTrust
stories.why_it_matters: HomeTrust Bancshares (NYSE: HTB) is acquiring Blue Ridge Bankshares (NYSE American: BRBS) in an all-stock merger valued at ~$448.1M ($4.28/share), expanding into Virginia to form a $7B+ Southeast commercial bank; expected to close early Q1 2027. Piper Sandler is financial adviser to HomeTrust (buy-side); Stephens advised Blue Ridge. A bank merger runs regulatory-approval and dual shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Piper Sandler (HomeTrust) — a ~$448M bank merger runs regulatory-approval and dual-company proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: HomeTrust agrees to acquire Blue Ridge Bankshares (~$448M)

stories.source: SEC EDGAR — Blue Ridge / HomeTrust merger press release (EX-99.1)

stories.headline: Accelerant's $4B+ Thoma Bravo take-private at $20.25/share advances; Morgan Stanley and Houlihan Lokey advise Accelerant, Wells Fargo advises Thoma Bravo
stories.why_it_matters: Accelerant Holdings (NYSE: ARX), the specialty-insurance risk-exchange platform, is being taken private by Thoma Bravo at $20.25/share (49% premium; $4B+ enterprise value). Morgan Stanley is exclusive financial adviser to Accelerant's Board and Houlihan Lokey advises the Special Committee (sell-side); BMO Capital Markets and Wells Fargo advise Thoma Bravo (buy-side). A sponsor take-private of an insurance-tech platform runs committed-financing, insurance-regulatory and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Morgan Stanley/Houlihan Lokey (Accelerant) and Wells Fargo (Thoma Bravo) — a $4B+ insurance-tech take-private runs committed-financing, insurance-regulatory and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: Accelerant agrees to $20.25/share take-private by Thoma Bravo ($4B+ EV)

stories.headline: Caesars' $31.00/share Fertitta take-private proxy remains on file; PJT Partners advises Caesars, Morgan Stanley advises Fertitta
stories.why_it_matters: Caesars Entertainment (Nasdaq: CZR) has a preliminary merger proxy (PREM14A) on file for its $31.00/share cash take-private by Fertitta Entertainment. PJT Partners is Caesars' exclusive financial adviser and fairness-opinion provider (sell-side), Morgan Stanley advises Fertitta (buy-side), and Jefferies advised the Icahn Group. A large gaming take-private runs committed-financing, multi-state gaming-license and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage PJT Partners (Caesars) and Morgan Stanley (Fertitta) — a $31.00/share gaming take-private runs committed-financing, gaming-license and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: Caesars board approves $31.00/share merger with Fertitta

stories.headline: Payoneer's $7.40/share Nuvei merger proxy remains on file; Goldman advises Nuvei
stories.why_it_matters: Payoneer Global (Nasdaq: PAYO) has a definitive merger proxy (DEFM14A) on file for its $7.40/share cash acquisition by Nuvei (Neon Maple Parent). Goldman Sachs advises Nuvei (buy-side); Qatalyst advised Payoneer. A cross-border fintech/payments take-private runs antitrust, money-transmitter-licensing and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Goldman (Nuvei) on the Payoneer acquisition — a cross-border payments take-private runs multi-jurisdiction licensing and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

stories.headline: Stocks pull back and the VIX pops ~8% as the week turns risk-off; Jefferies again the advisory laggard
stories.why_it_matters: Equities slipped midday Aug 18 (S&P -0.32% to ~7,704, Nasdaq -0.51%, Dow -0.65%), with the VIX jumping ~7.6% to ~15.7 and the 10Y near ~4.72%. Bank stocks were mixed — Lazard (+1.6%) and Morgan Stanley (+0.6%) held up while Goldman (-0.2%), JPMorgan (-0.5%) and especially Jefferies (-2.2%) lagged. The uptick in volatility against a still-busy deal calendar (BioMarin/Alesta, TTM/Epiq, plus Huntsman/Olin heading to an Aug 25 vote) is a reminder that mandate momentum, not the daily tape, is the read on advisory pipeline.
stories.suggested_action: Lean on the deal calendar, not a risk-off tape — a VIX pop alongside live proxy votes and fresh signings is a cue to keep the conversation on execution timelines and room readiness.

Bank stocks were mixed — Lazard (+1.6%) and Morgan Stanley (+0.6%) held up, while Goldman (-0.2%), JPMorgan (-0.5%) and Jefferies (-2.2%) lagged, Jefferies again the weakest of the pure-play advisers. Values are live Aug 18 midday levels.

talking_point.quote: Volatility popped Tuesday — the VIX up ~8% on a down tape — but the deal desk stayed busy: BioMarin's up-to-$490M buy of Alesta (Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan), TTM's $1.1B Epiq deal, and Huntsman/Olin heading to its Aug 25 shareholder votes (Citi, Morgan Stanley, Lazard). Volatility is exactly when signed mandates and vote calendars matter more than the tape. Which of your live processes has the nearest diligence or vote milestone this week?
talking_point.use_with: Healthcare, industrials/chemicals, defense and FIG coverage teams (esp. Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Citi, Lazard, Guggenheim, Barclays, BofA, Piper Sandler)
talking_point.context: Pairs a volatility uptick with a busy signing/vote calendar — a way to keep the conversation on execution timelines rather than the daily tape.

items.lead: Karyopharm disclosed (8-K, Aug 13) that it, 'together with its financial advisor Centerview Partners and other advisors, is actively evaluating a range of financing opportunities and strategic alternatives,' with cash runway only into September 2026 and stated going-concern doubt.
items.why_unverified: Company-disclosed review confirmed in a primary 8-K with a covered adviser (Centerview) already engaged — but no transaction, buyer, price or timeline, and it's distress-driven (financing or sale). A named-adviser early signal, not a mandate: reach out early, don't quote a deal.
